blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has thanked the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) member-states and China for remaining committed to concluding negotiations on a Code of Conduct (COC) in the South China Sea, despite failing to finalize it in 2026. In a press briefing on Tuesday following the closing ceremonies of the Philippines’ hosting of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits, Marcos said Asean member-states and China had reaffirmed their commitment to sustaining earlier efforts to conclude the COC.
